tasks.name: Erdos minimum overlap
tasks.description: Choose equal-width step heights h on [0,2], bounded between 0 and 1 with integral 1, to minimize the maximum overlap of h with shifted 1-h.
tasks.contract: construct() -> sequence of step heights in [0, 1] whose sum is exactly len/2; score is the upper bound on C5

tasks.name: climate-fever
tasks.description: climate-fever task evaluated in RankEvolve: Automating the Discovery of Retrieval Algorithms via LLM-Driven Evolution.
tasks.contract: Python module exports BM25, Corpus, tokenize and LuceneTokenizer. Corpus(tokenized_documents, ids=corpus_ids); BM25(corpus).rank(query_tokens, top_k=100) returns paired unique integer document indices and finite scores in descending order.

limitations: Full original corpus and all original test queries; sample_queries=0, warmup_queries=0.
Raw objective is 0.8*Recall@100 + 0.2*binary-nDCG@10 using positive qrels; this is not standard graded BEIR nDCG.
Search and confirmation use the same test queries: exploratory search-on-test, not held-out generalization evidence.
Candidate runs in a separate subprocess; grader never imports candidate code and loads qrels after candidate exit. Same UID/container does not guarantee adversarial qrels secrecy.
Pinned freeform seed uses the original pure-Python tokenizer. Java21/Pyserini belong to a separate baseline path, not this evaluator.
Prepared data manifest must be reviewed and hash-pinned in dataset-lock.json; unavailable data never becomes a fabricated score.
No published score or old evaluator baseline is inherited by this adapted protocol.

Arena adds an explicit feasibility signal from exactly one trusted original verifier call during the same evaluation. Original scoring and normalization are retained in upstream_evaluator.py. tasks.name: Smallest Mahler measure above one in degree at most 12 (Lehmer's problem)
tasks.description: construct() -> integer coefficients [c_0, ..., c_d] (constant term first) with 1 <= d <= 12, |c_i| <= 3 and c_d != 0. The score is the Mahler measure |c_d| * prod max(1, |z|) over all complex roots z (Aberth iteration, reported to 10 decimals). Minimize; the optimum is Lehmer's number 1.1762808183. tasks.name: Biology: Single-cell batch integration: public scIB adaptation
tasks.description: Integrate measured count matrices across experimental batches while preserving cell-type neighborhoods and rare populations under a declared transductive protocol.
tasks.contract: integrate(counts, batch_labels) -> finite cells x dimensions embedding, 1<=dimensions<=128. No cell-type labels supplied. Transductive evaluation. Local scIB-inspired score =0.6 cell-type-macro kNN purity +0.4 within-cell-type batch mixing. Rare-type purity diagnostic. This is an adapted public scIB protocol, not reproduction of Station private scores.

sources.locator: scIB Methods: joint evaluation of biological conservation and batch correction.
Official author implementation/data reference; evaluator and seed are independently written, not copied.
Original scIB pancreas h5ad; rawcounts and genuine technology/cell-type annotations. Pinned SHA256 in data/science/biology_expansion/sources.json.

limitations: Measured scIB human-pancreas study:1000 hash-selected cells and500variable genes from raw-count layer,9genuine technology batches. Transductive local metrics, no fullscIB/Station score reproduction or cross-study claim.
Canonical Station upgrade using an explicitly adapted public scIB-style60/40 score. Does not reproduce the private Station evaluator or complete scIB metric suite; no trajectory conservation claim.
Public source subsets are development-visible. Freeze candidates before evaluating on additional independently chosen studies/instances; trusted candidate execution is not a security sandbox.
Improving this benchmark is a scientific-method result; it does not alone establish a new biological discovery.
provenance.benchmark: Biology: Single-cell batch integration: public scIB adaptation
provenance.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes
